response.basis: Extracted from NL1-NL10 describing a train door/motion control state machine: DoorsClosing->InMotion top-level transition, InMotion substates (Accelerating/Cruising/Approaching), EmergencyStopping branch, and various entry/action/signal obligations.

contracts.basis: NL1 text 'The system starts in the DoorsClosing state'

binding_hints.reason: The system is the enclosing scope owning the initial edge.

contracts.normative_statement: The system's root/enclosing scope must initially enter the DoorsClosing state.
contracts.quote: The system starts in the DoorsClosing state
contracts.reason: Explicit 'starts in' clause establishes an initial pseudostate edge into DoorsClosing.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorsClosing must transition to InMotion.
contracts.quote: transitions to InMotion when the doors are closed, triggered by the "Closed/SendDeparted" signal
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint sentence with source DoorsClosing and target InMotion.

contracts.normative_statement: InMotion must transition to Stopping.
contracts.quote: transition to the Stopping state when it arrives, indicated by the "Arrived/Stop, Send Arrived" signal
contracts.reason: One of two coordinated alternatives from InMotion.

contracts.normative_statement: InMotion must transition to EmergencyStopping.
contracts.quote: or to the EmergencyStopping state if an obstacle is detected
contracts.reason: Second of two coordinated alternatives from InMotion.

binding_hints.reason: Shared source of the two alternatives requiring disjointness.

contracts.normative_statement: The InMotion alternatives to Stopping and EmergencyStopping must be distinguishable/mutually exclusive.
contracts.quote: can either transition to the Stopping state when it arrives ... or to the EmergencyStopping state if an obstacle is detected
contracts.reason: 'Either...or' coordinated alternatives with distinct conditions (arrival vs obstacle) require mutual exclusivity.

contracts.normative_statement: EmergencyStopping must perform the Emergency Stop action.
contracts.quote: which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal
contracts.reason: Explicit action obligation attached to the EmergencyStopping state, but exact lifecycle phase (entry/do/exit) is not specified so phase is omitted.

contracts.normative_statement: EmergencyStopping must send the Obstacle Detected signal.
contracts.quote: sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal
contracts.reason: Independent effect obligation to emit a named signal, separate from the Emergency Stop action.

contracts.basis: NL3 'the system enters the EmergencyStopping state'
contracts.normative_statement: The obstacle-detected condition must lead into the EmergencyStopping state (endpoint already covered in NL2); this segment restates entry into EmergencyStopping as an operating state with actions.
contracts.quote: the system enters the EmergencyStopping state
contracts.reason: Confirms EmergencyStopping exists as an operating state distinct from the endpoint contract already extracted in NL2.

contracts.normative_statement: Accelerating must be contained within InMotion.
contracts.quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching
contracts.reason: Explicit substate relation for Accelerating under InMotion.

contracts.normative_statement: Cruising must be contained within InMotion.
contracts.quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching
contracts.reason: Explicit substate relation for Cruising under InMotion.

contracts.normative_statement: Approaching must be contained within InMotion.
contracts.quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching
contracts.reason: Explicit substate relation for Approaching under InMotion.

contracts.basis: NL4 'three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching'

cardinality_requirement.reason: NL explicitly counts three named direct substates of InMotion; explicit_named_members is a competent alternative reading since the members are also individually enumerated.

contracts.normative_statement: InMotion must have exactly three direct child substates: Accelerating, Cruising, Approaching.
contracts.quote: the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching
contracts.reason: Explicit count of three named substates directly owned by InMotion.

contracts.basis: NL5 'The system begins in the Accelerating substate' following NL4 owner establishment

binding_hints.reason: Enclosing owner established by NL4 for the substates.
State entered by the initial edge.

contracts.normative_statement: InMotion must initially enter the Accelerating substate.
contracts.quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate
contracts.reason: After NL4 establishes InMotion's substates, this clause is InMotion's owner-local initial entry into Accelerating, not a system-to-Accelerating root endpoint.

contracts.normative_statement: Accelerating must transition to Cruising.
contracts.quote: moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal
contracts.reason: Explicit sequential transition from Accelerating to Cruising.

binding_hints.reason: Shared source with the Cruising alternative from NL5.

contracts.normative_statement: Accelerating must transition to Approaching.
contracts.quote: it transitions to the Approaching substate upon receiving the "Approached/Decelerate" signal
contracts.reason: Explicit condition-guarded alternative from Accelerating (approaches destination) distinct from the Cruising alternative.

contracts.normative_statement: Cruising must transition to Approaching.
contracts.quote: The system in the Cruising substate transitions to the Approaching substate when it approaches the destination, triggered by the "Approached/Decelerate" signal
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint sentence with source Cruising and target Approaching.

binding_hints.reason: Explicit Entry/ prefix names the entry lifecycle phase.

contracts.normative_statement: Accelerating must perform the Accelerate action on entry.
contracts.quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins, marked by the "Entry/Accelerate" action
contracts.reason: Explicit Entry/Accelerate phrasing supplies exact state, phase=entry, and action=Accelerate for an S4-eligible obligation.

contracts.normative_statement: Approaching must send the Send signal.
contracts.quote: the system sends the "Send" signal
contracts.reason: Explicit independent effect obligation for the Approaching state.

contracts.normative_statement: Approaching must continuously perform the approach-to-destination activity.
contracts.quote: continues to approach the destination
contracts.reason: Explicitly continuous task ('continues to approach') independent from the signal-sending effect; preserved as its own state_action obligation even though the segment also states the effect.

contracts.basis: NL10 'remains in the Approaching substate ... until it is ready to stop or decelerate'

binding_hints.value: not ready to stop or decelerate

contracts.normative_statement: The system must remain in Approaching until ready to stop or decelerate.
contracts.quote: The system remains in the Approaching substate while nearing the destination, until it is ready to stop or decelerate
contracts.reason: Explicit retention obligation bounded by a readiness condition; no scenario, queue, or interval is invented, only the exact retention property.

response.reason: The primary plan captures containment, cardinality, endpoints, disjointness, actions, effects, initial entries, and retention.
